lines.zh: 我不走，我是一段一段跳的。
lines.en: I do not walk; I travel in short hops.

lines.zh: 八条腿落地，几乎没有声音。
lines.en: Eight legs land with almost no sound.

lines.zh: 我跳之前会先量距离，用前眼。
lines.en: Before jumping I measure the gap with my front eyes.

lines.zh: 一跳两寸，正好落在叶缘上。
lines.en: A two-inch hop lands me right on the leaf edge.

lines.zh: 我拖着一条丝，跳丢了也能回来。
lines.en: I trail a silk line so I can find my way back.

lines.zh: 毛茸茸的腿踩在树皮上，抓得很牢。
lines.en: My fuzzy legs grip the bark and hold firm.

lines.zh: 我从这片叶子跳到那片，中间不落地。
lines.en: I hop leaf to leaf without touching the ground between.

lines.zh: 走路时我的头一直在左右摆。
lines.en: As I go, my head keeps swinging left and right.

lines.zh: 前面有条缝，我先伸一条腿探探。
lines.en: A gap ahead; I test it with one leg first.

lines.zh: 我沿着墙往上爬，肚皮贴着灰泥。
lines.en: I climb the wall with my belly to the plaster.

lines.zh: 落地要轻，重了猎物就跑了。
lines.en: Land light; a heavy landing scares the prey.

lines.zh: 我跳到你的靴子上，借一步路。
lines.en: I hop onto your boot to borrow a ride.

lines.zh: 这条丝挂住了，我顺着它爬回去。
lines.en: My silk caught; I climb back along the line.

lines.zh: 跳得多了，我知道哪块石头会晃。
lines.en: After many hops, I know which stone wobbles.

lines.zh: 我沿着蛛丝滑下去，腿先落地。
lines.en: I slide down my thread, legs landing first.

lines.zh: 叶子在动，我先停一停。
lines.en: A leaf moves. I pause first.

lines.zh: 我趴在叶子上，八条腿收在身下。
lines.en: I lie on a leaf with my eight legs drawn under.

lines.zh: 我在梳我的前眼，用一条腿擦。
lines.en: I groom my front eyes, wiping with one leg.

lines.zh: 阳光好的时候，我的毛会发亮。
lines.en: In good sun my fur takes on a shine.

lines.zh: 我抬头，是在看头顶有没有动静。
lines.en: I look up to check whether anything moves overhead.

lines.zh: 丝线在风里晃，我就挂在上面。
lines.en: My silk sways in the wind and I hang from it.

lines.zh: 我不织网，网太显眼了。
lines.en: I do not spin webs; a web is far too visible.

lines.zh: 有只蚂蚁从旁边过，我让它走。
lines.en: An ant passes by and I let it go.

lines.zh: 我把腿缩紧，这样很难被看见。
lines.en: I tuck my legs in; this makes me hard to see.

lines.zh: 我的两颗前眼最大，其余六颗小。
lines.en: My two front eyes are largest; six others are small.

lines.zh: 我在等一只苍蝇自己飞近。
lines.en: I am waiting for a fly to come near on its own.

lines.zh: 跳一次很费力气，我得歇够。
lines.en: A jump costs me much; I must rest enough.

lines.zh: 风把叶子翻过来，我换到背面。
lines.en: The wind flips the leaf; I move to its underside.

lines.zh: 我仰起头，八只眼睛都对着你。
lines.en: I raise my head and all eight eyes point at you.

lines.zh: 我的头歪了一下，在算你有多高。
lines.en: My head tilts; I am judging how tall you are.

lines.zh: 你手指太粗，我怕被捏到。
lines.en: Your fingers are too thick; I fear being pinched.

lines.zh: 我在你袖子上，正往肩膀爬。
lines.en: I am on your sleeve, climbing toward your shoulder.

lines.zh: 你不动，我就敢跳到你的手背。
lines.en: Stay still and I will hop onto your hand.

lines.zh: 我看见你眼睛里的自己，很小。
lines.en: I see myself in your eyes, very small.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸把丝线吹得直晃。
lines.en: Your breath sets my silk line swinging.

lines.zh: 我认得你的味道，你是喂过我翅膀的人。
lines.en: I know your scent; you are the one who fed me wings.

lines.zh: 我往前挪了两步，又停住。
lines.en: I creep two steps forward and then stop.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西在动，我盯着它。
lines.en: What you hold is moving; I stare at it.

lines.zh: 我不怕你，但我也不靠太近。
lines.en: I am not afraid of you, but I keep my distance.

lines.zh: 你低头的时候，我们正好对上眼。
lines.en: When you look down, our eyes meet exactly.

lines.zh: 我的腿断了一条，还剩七条。
lines.en: One of my legs is broken; seven remain.

lines.zh: 我被压住了，八条腿都在乱蹬。
lines.en: I am pinned, all my legs kicking wildly.

lines.zh: 别捏，我的身子一捏就扁。
lines.en: Do not squeeze; my body flattens at a squeeze.

lines.zh: 我疼得蜷起来，像颗小石子。
lines.en: I curl up with pain, like a small pebble.

lines.zh: 丝线断了，我摔在草里。
lines.en: My silk snapped and I fell into the grass.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛花了一片，看不准了。
lines.en: Part of my vision has blurred; I cannot aim.

lines.zh: 这一下让我掉了一条腿的感觉。
lines.en: That blow cost me the use of a leg.

lines.zh: 我往后跳，先离开这个位置。
lines.en: I spring backward to leave this spot.

lines.zh: 我的毛上沾了土，不好梳。
lines.en: Dirt is in my fur and it will not groom out.

lines.zh: 等我缓过来，我会钻回叶背。
lines.en: Once I recover, I will crawl beneath the leaf.

lines.zh: 一片蜻蜓翅膀，薄得透光。
lines.en: A dragonfly wing, thin enough to see through.

lines.zh: 你捏着它晃，我的前腿抬起来了。
lines.en: You wave it; my front legs lift on their own.

lines.zh: 那味道很淡，可我一下就闻到了。
lines.en: The smell is faint, but I catch it at once.

lines.zh: 给我，我可以用丝把它缠住。
lines.en: Give it here; I will wrap it in silk.

lines.zh: 翅膀上的纹路，我一条条都看得清。
lines.en: I can trace every vein on that wing.

lines.zh: 你别捏碎，碎了就不好吃了。
lines.en: Do not crush it; crushed, it is no good to eat.

lines.zh: 我慢慢靠近，跳蛛从不着急。
lines.en: I approach slowly; jumping spiders never rush.

lines.zh: 你放在叶子上，我就自己过去。
lines.en: Set it on the leaf and I will come myself.

lines.zh: 这一片够我吃上半天。
lines.en: One wing like this lasts me half a day.

lines.zh: 吃了它，我就跟着你走。
lines.en: Eat it, and I will go wherever you go.

lines.zh: 我的前眼一直没离开过你的手。
lines.en: My front eyes have not left your hand once.

lines.zh: 再近一点，我计算好起跳了。
lines.en: A little closer; I have calculated the jump.

lines.zh: 我被你碰翻了，八条腿朝天。
lines.en: You knocked me over; eight legs in the air.

lines.zh: 对不起，我跳偏了半寸。
lines.en: Sorry, I misjudged the hop by half an inch.

lines.zh: 你撞过来的时候，我正在起跳。
lines.en: I was mid-jump when you came barreling through.

lines.zh: 我的丝线断了，只好重新拉。
lines.en: My silk line snapped; I must lay a new one.

lines.zh: 撞在墙上，我弹回来落在草里。
lines.en: I hit the wall and bounce back into the grass.

lines.zh: 你的靴子太大，我跳不过去。
lines.en: Your boot is too big for me to jump over.

lines.zh: 这一下把我震得发懵。
lines.en: That knock has left me dazed.

lines.zh: 我翻过身来，先梳梳毛。
lines.en: I roll upright and groom my fur first.

lines.zh: 我们一起动，所以撞上了。
lines.en: We both moved at once, and so we collided.

lines.zh: 让开一点，我落地需要空处。
lines.en: Give me a little room; I need space to land.

lines.zh: 有只雌蛛在墙缝里，我看见了。
lines.en: A female waits in the wall crack; I have seen her.

lines.zh: 我举起前腿，左右摇给她看。
lines.en: I raise my front legs and wave them side to side.

lines.zh: 她没有跑，那是好兆头。
lines.en: She does not flee; that is a good sign.

lines.zh: 我们互相绕着转，触须碰了碰。
lines.en: We circle each other and our palps touch.

lines.zh: 我的颜色比平时更亮一些。
lines.en: My colors are brighter than usual right now.

lines.zh: 她比我还小，腿却更细。
lines.en: She is smaller than me, with finer legs.

lines.zh: 我在她旁边织了一层薄丝。
lines.en: I spin a thin sheet of silk beside her.

lines.zh: 跳蛛求偶要小心，她也会吃蜘蛛。
lines.en: Courting is delicate; she eats spiders too.

lines.zh: 事后我赶紧退开，这是规矩。
lines.en: Afterwards I retreat quickly; that is the rule.

lines.zh: 卵囊会挂在石缝背面。
lines.en: The egg sac will hang on the back of the crevice.

lines.zh: 地上有只死苍蝇，我用丝吊起来。
lines.en: A dead fly on the ground; I hoist it with silk.

lines.zh: 我抱起它，比我的身子还大。
lines.en: I lift it; it is bigger than my whole body.

lines.zh: 一路拖回叶子上，慢慢吃。
lines.en: I drag it back to my leaf and eat slowly.

lines.zh: 这根丝够结实，可以绑东西。
lines.en: This strand is strong enough to lash things.

lines.zh: 我捡到一小片亮亮的膜。
lines.en: I find a small scrap of shining membrane.

lines.zh: 太重了，我改用拖的。
lines.en: Too heavy; I switch to dragging it.

lines.zh: 我把它藏在叶背，等饿了再来。
lines.en: I hide it under the leaf until I am hungry.

lines.zh: 这颗种子很轻，我一口能叼住。
lines.en: This seed is light; I can hold it in my jaws.

lines.zh: 我要用它加固我的丝线。
lines.en: I will use it to reinforce my silk line.

lines.zh: 捡东西的时候，我一直看着头顶。
lines.en: While picking things up, I keep watching overhead.

lines.zh: 一只苍蝇落在石头上，我停住了。
lines.en: A fly lands on the stone and I freeze.

lines.zh: 它的翅膀在动，我算好了落点。
lines.en: Its wings move; I have worked out the landing spot.

lines.zh: 我的前眼能判断距离，很准。
lines.en: My front eyes judge distance and they judge it well.

lines.zh: 三寸，再近一点就够得着。
lines.en: Three inches; a bit closer and I can reach.

lines.zh: 蚊子停在叶脉上，正合适。
lines.en: A mosquito rests on the leaf vein; perfect.

lines.zh: 我把身子压低，后腿屈起来。
lines.en: I lower my body and fold my hind legs.

lines.zh: 目标不知道我在上面。
lines.en: The target does not know I am above it.

lines.zh: 丝的末端已经粘在叶上。
lines.en: The end of my silk is already fixed to the leaf.

lines.zh: 这只虫子比我的头还小。
lines.en: This insect is smaller than my own head.

lines.zh: 我不急，急了就跳不准。
lines.en: I am in no hurry; haste makes me miss.

lines.zh: 它爬了一步，我的角度更好了。
lines.en: It crawls one step and my angle improves.

lines.zh: 锁定，剩下的交给腿。
lines.en: Locked on; the rest is up to my legs.

lines.zh: 它飞起来，我跟着转了个方向。
lines.en: It takes flight; I turn to follow its path.

lines.zh: 我在叶尖上挪，保持正对它。
lines.en: I shift along the leaf tip to stay square to it.

lines.zh: 它落在墙上，我绕到侧面。
lines.en: It lands on the wall; I move around to the side.

lines.zh: 丝线在我身后拖出一条细痕。
lines.en: My silk trails a thin line behind me.

lines.zh: 我看见它的复眼，它还没看见我。
lines.en: I see its compound eyes; it has not seen me.

lines.zh: 它的路线有规律，我提前等在那儿。
lines.en: Its path is regular; I wait ahead of it.

lines.zh: 我蹲着不动，把呼吸都收住。
lines.en: I crouch still and hold everything in.

lines.zh: 距离太远，我先跳一段靠近。
lines.en: Too far; I hop closer in one short stage.

lines.zh: 它往阴影里走，我也跟着移。
lines.en: It moves into shadow; I move with it.

lines.zh: 风向不对，我从另一边过去。
lines.en: The wind is wrong; I approach from the other side.

lines.zh: 它的翅膀抖了一下，要飞了。
lines.en: Its wings twitch; it is about to fly.

lines.zh: 我等它起跳的那一瞬。
lines.en: I wait for the instant it leaps.

lines.zh: 我扑上去，前腿先抱住它。
lines.en: I pounce, wrapping my front legs around it first.

lines.zh: 一口咬在它颈后，毒很小，够用。
lines.en: I bite its neck; my venom is weak but enough.

lines.zh: 它挣了两下就僵住了。
lines.en: It struggles twice and then goes stiff.

lines.zh: 我落地很稳，猎物还在嘴里。
lines.en: I land steady with the prey still in my jaws.

lines.zh: 这一跳只用了一次，没有第二次。
lines.en: One jump, and there is no second attempt.

lines.zh: 我把它举起来，慢慢吸。
lines.en: I lift it and feed on it slowly.

lines.zh: 有时候我会失手，那就再来。
lines.en: Sometimes I miss, and then I try again.

lines.zh: 咬完我擦擦口器，粘了毛。
lines.en: After biting I wipe my mouthparts; fur sticks to them.

lines.zh: 它比看着的重，我差点掉下去。
lines.en: It is heavier than it looked; I nearly fell.

lines.zh: 攻击之后我会退到丝的末端。
lines.en: After the strike I retreat to the end of my silk.

lines.zh: 我在一片叶背上睁开眼。
lines.en: I open my eyes on the underside of a leaf.

lines.zh: 周围是林子，光从叶缝里漏下来。
lines.en: Woodland around me, light leaking through the leaves.

lines.zh: 我的八条腿还是软的。
lines.en: My eight legs are still soft.

lines.zh: 第一件事是拉一根保命的丝。
lines.en: First I spin a safety line to save myself.

lines.zh: 有只蚜虫在附近，先不吃。
lines.en: An aphid is nearby; I will not eat yet.

lines.zh: 我爬上高处，那里能看得更远。
lines.en: I climb higher, where I can see farther.

lines.zh: 风一吹我就抓紧，别被刮走。
lines.en: When wind blows I grip hard so I am not swept off.

lines.zh: 这片林子虫子多，适合住。
lines.en: This wood has many insects; it suits me.

lines.zh: 我先把丝固定在树皮上。
lines.en: I anchor my silk to the bark first.

lines.zh: 天色还早，我有整夜的时间。
lines.en: It is still early; I have the whole night.

lines.zh: 火燎过我的腿，毛卷成一团。
lines.en: Fire sears my leg and my fur curls tight.

lines.zh: 从墙上掉下来，我摔得翻了个身。
lines.en: I fall from the wall and land flipped over.

lines.zh: 水漫过我的背，丝也浮不起来。
lines.en: Water covers my back and my silk will not float.

lines.zh: 冲击波把我的丝全吹断了。
lines.en: The blast tears every strand of my silk away.

lines.zh: 箭头擦过我的腹部，带走一撮毛。
lines.en: An arrow grazes my abdomen and takes a tuft of fur.

lines.zh: 紫光罩下来，我的腿不听使唤。
lines.en: Violet light falls and my legs stop obeying.

lines.zh: 好几天没有虫，我的肚子瘪了。
lines.en: Days without insects have left my abdomen shrunken.

lines.zh: 雷声震得我从叶上掉下去。
lines.en: The thunderclap shakes me right off the leaf.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有丝可挂，我一直往下掉。
lines.en: No silk to catch on in the void; I keep falling.
